title: Absolute waste of time
body: Could have finished your school project before uploading here. Found a bug in 10 mins. The manage permissions doesn’t work. Some functions were blocked for my friend and not for me. I just wasted an hour planning and writing habits and I am deleting the app right now. Hope you will actually take time to test your application and fix your errors.
author: Zeykci

title: Bloatware
body: Fifteen minutes in I was still in onboarding flow, clicking “I promise” buttons under irrelevant resolutions and scrolling through pictures with fat people turning thin. I just need to track my exercises and to know if I watered my plants this week, I’m not starting some kind of spiritual wellness journey here

author: k1tketi

title: Just not reliable
body:
Ok after a couple of serious bugs I’m ready to write a review. Do not use!

Firstly, after of 2 months of use it has started to ignore week start day. My week starts on Mondays like half of the worlds. The app decided that Friday is fine to start a week. Reinstalling didn’t help.

Secondly, I decided to remove old habits. When I pressed delete on one of my old archived habits, one of my active ones was deleted. My finger was never where all my active habits are placed. This is why this app cannot be trusted. Removing it and looking for another one.
